{{Quote|As a symbol of hope and redemption in the face of Sith atrocities, the Republic has begun an unlikely effort to re-colonize Taris, establishing a spaceport, military base and the beginning of settlements amid the ruins.|A HoloNet dossier on Taris during the Cold War|<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|taris|Taris}}</ref>}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] era that followed the [[Great Galactic War]], the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] undertook the '''Taris Resettlement Initiative''', an effort to restore the ruined world of [[Taris/Legends|Taris]]. The goal of the program was to turn the post-apocalyptic swampland that dominated the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] into a habitable Republic world.<ref name="Encyclopedia" /> Taris had been ruined [[3956 BBY|three centuries prior]], when the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Malak]] [[Destruction of Taris|razed]] the [[Ecumenopolis/Legends|ecumenopolis]] in an effort to find [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] [[Bastila Shan]] and bring victory to his [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]] in the [[Jedi Civil War]].<ref name="KOTOR">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>

After the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] victory in the Great Galactic War,<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Republic Senate]] sought to pursue a colonization effort on Taris in order to score a symbolic victory against the [[Sith/Legends|Sith's]] aggression. The teams on the planet managed to establish a [[Republic Military/Legends|military]] base, a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]], and a number of settlements, but ran into difficulties while traversing the ruins of the felled Taris skyline. Additionally, [[Rakghoul|victims]] of the [[Rakghoul plague/Legends|Rakghoul plague]] still survived on the planet and posed a significant threat to the settlers. The Empire also posed a threat to the initiative, as a successful recolonization effort would show the people of the Republic that worlds could indeed recover after being attacked by the Sith.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />

The Republic had initial success with the resettlement. However, led by [[Darth Gravus]], the Empire eliminated key people to the initiative and sabotaged it, thus making it a failure.<ref name="Encyclopedia" />
